# Copilot instructions: generated docs policy

Do not edit generated documentation files:

- `docs/**` (e.g. `docs/<action>/vN.md`)
- `<action>/README.md` (action folder READMEs)
- Root `README.md` content between `<!-- LATEST_TAGS_START -->` and `<!-- LATEST_TAGS_END -->`

Write manual action documentation only in optional `<action>/DOCS.md` (keep concise; do not duplicate generated inputs/outputs/usage/technical sections; avoid H1 headings).

Docs are generated by `.github/workflows/release-action.yml` running:

- `.github/workflows/scripts/generate_action_docs.py <action> <version>`

The generator renders from `action.yml` (+ optional `DOCS.md`) and writes `docs/<action>/<version>.md` + `<action>/README.md`.
